reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-01 attaches each retained filestate to an ifile and owns its cache nodes/ordinary FD separately from borrowed stdin or help data.
owner_creation.invariant: File identity anchors retained input lifetime.
limitations: The ifile, filestate, descriptor and cache nodes are distinct OWN-01 owners.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-01 retains curr/old-ifile, active thisfile, LRU/hash and rendering aliases; a raw hold count is not a generation-checked handle.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Raw retained aliases cannot be justified by a count alone.
limitations: An IFILE handle is not an owning reference that prevents del_ifile.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-01 calls mark, input-disposal and render/filter operations directly while other stages may retain aliases into those owners.
callback_targets.invariant: Cross-module calls require explicit alias retirement order.
limitations: Direct fatal-cleanup calls can revisit active filestate aliases.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-01 preserves nonseekable state for navigation, while permanent del_ifile first clears external aliases and then disposes the retained state.
invalidation.invariant: A navigation lifetime is longer than the active-file selection.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-01 publishes initialized list/hash state before attachment, but file-list/index updates and render output positions commit separately.
mutation_commit.invariant: Publication must keep file and buffer identity coherent.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-01 frees cache nodes/state through disposal, then unlinks and frees ifile names/node; CH_KEEPOPEN stdin is never closed by disposal.
release_pair.invariant: One resource must have one designated close/free owner.
limitations: Borrowed fd 0 and CH_KEEPOPEN descriptors cannot be closed as ordinary owned files.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-01 cleanup preserves the first-buffer sentinel distinction: failed ch_addbuf leaves no payload node, reports once and returns -1. dispose_ifile_state detaches ifile/thisfile, frees cache nodes, closes only an ordinary owned FD and frees state. del_ifile then unlinks the ifile and frees both names and its node; borrowed stdin is not an owned close target.
error_cleanup.invariant: Source analysis cannot replace regression-based closure.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-01 has no guarded transaction excluding asynchronous quit from active alias/list mutation, so its raw retained-owner hazard remains open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Owner retirement belongs to controlled command-loop execution.
limitations: Fresh cycle analysis preserves IND-MEM-FIRSTBUF and IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE as open; no approval is inherited from their historical passing tests.

src/signal.rs.relationship: terminate at src/signal.rs:83-85 calls quit. OWN-01 traces the resulting edit/close_file/dispose path that can revisit filestate, cache and ifile owners during cleanup.
